title: Office - B. Add inspection to a work order line
preconds: Logged in as Office. WOL View only, but Settings + Service ON. A work order with at least one line exists.
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open a work order and locate a line.
3. Open the three-dot menu on the line.
4. Select Add Inspection and choose a template.
expected: Step 3: Add Inspection is NOT available - role lacks Work Order Lines: Create and Edit (SV-8095 AC2).
